title: The Throne of God
lead: God is pictured as a king on a throne: above the cherubim of the ark (Exodus 25:22; 1 Samuel 4:4), high and lifted up in Isaiah 6, a fiery throne in Daniel 7:9, and at the center of heaven in Revelation 4–5, which uses the word throne 47 times. David's throne, promised to last forever (2 Samuel 7:16), is the earthly side of the picture.
